text:
sec-bot: DAST nightly job for payments-service: spike in findings (42 -> 35 tagged 'auth-bypass'). Scanner reported 403 when using ephemeral KMS-based token.
Ava: saw the alert, is this related to the ephemeral token rollout?
Sam: yes, we rolled scanner SA to use KMS-wrapped short-lived tokens last Wed.
Maria: not seeing KMS decrypt entries — app logs only show `403: token signature invalid`.
Kevin: could be RBAC on the key (missing decrypt) or impersonation scope mismatch.
Ava: can you paste the scanner request so I can repro locally?
Sam: ```
# fetch token and hit login
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /tmp/scanner_token)" https://dast-runner.internal/payments/login -v
# note: scanner_token retrieved via kms-decrypt by ephemeral-agent
```
Maria: I ran that and KMS shows no grant logs. App shows signature invalid.
Kevin: check CloudTrail filter for the key ID + serviceAccount impersonation audit entries; sometimes logs are under resource-name not principal.
Ava: Plan: Sam to add temporary `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for scanner SA in staging and rerun DAST; Maria to capture audit exports; I'll coordinate infra and security.
Sam: On it. I'll run:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/rdw/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/dast-scanner-key --member=serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
Maria: also update triage: infra-caused FP when scanner returns 403 with token signature text; auto-tag those.
Kevin: warning — granting decrypt is sensitive. Ensure key usage logs flow to secure bucket and alert on unusual decrypt counts.
Ava: +1. Update runbook to 90d retention for KMS decrypt events for scanner keys.
Sam: staging change applied, rerun started. sec-bot will post results.
sec-bot: DAST rerun finished: FPs down to 6. KMS decrypt logs now appear for scanner SA. Plan prod rollout tomorrow 10:00 PDT; change request and privileged approval required.
Maria: I'll open PR to update triage playbook and add checklist for scanner key rollouts (audit export + RBAC verification).
Ava: thanks team. Follow-ups: create SOC ticket SOC-424 (KMS-audit-export) and schedule postmortem if prod shows >10 FPs after rollout. Closing unless objections.
